answer: Neighborhood bridge centrality. Each agent’s routing score is the count of distinct host clusters it uniquely connects, capped by the smallest cluster’s size. A sybil swarm spawned into one nebula of adjacent hosts adds no bridge value, so its score stays near baseline. Honest agents at the network zenith span unrelated regions and earn high weights. Enforcement: messages from low-score agents are queued behind a river of verified relays, delaying delivery.
